title: Grounding gate cannot tell WHO a quote names: 'Thanks Rashi' said by the host before another speaker's block ships that block as Rashi
evidence: groundSpeakerProposals with host spk:0 turns 'Thanks Rashi, that was clear. Now over to our next speaker.' / 'Thank you Rashi, great point. Next up we have a speaker on visas.' each immediately BEFORE a spk:2 block; spk:1 (the real Rashi) speaks before each. Three identical runs proposing {label:spk:2,name:Rashi,kind:address} (and the same with kind:called-on) return resolved=[[spk:2,Rashi]] (wrong identity). Control kind:thanks on spk:1 correctly ships spk:1. Cause: groundEntry checks only that the name occurs in the quote and the kind-to-block direction; thanks-to-previous-speaker and greet patterns recur every handover so the 2-distinct-quote-turn corroboration is satisfied by the same wrong pattern. Bar 1/2 risk (silent wrong identity written to KB).
fix_direction: Reject a quote whose name-bearing sentence also bounds a different block (the name's own previous-block speaker: if the quote turn directly follows a block of another label, a before-bound kind must not bind unless the quote does not read as thanks/closing); or require the model to name the sentence role and verify the named person is not the speaker of the adjacent preceding block; add regression with this exact fixture and re-measure on the gold stress set.

title: Referent binding still ships wrong names: a second name in a forward-cue quote, and a one-turn backchannel block between quote and answer
evidence: At 5fa25015, 3 identical runs, groundSpeakerProposals. (a) host spk:0 'Rashi, can you hand over to Ruby for the next part?' + cohost spk:3 'Rashi, could you hand over to Ruby after fees?', each followed by spk:1 (the real Rashi); proposals {spk:1,Ruby,handover} ships spk:1=Ruby (also with kind address). (b) 'Welcome Ruby, and Rashi will go first today.' / 'Hello Ruby, Rashi will now present.' before spk:1 (Rashi): {spk:1,Ruby,address} ships spk:1=Ruby. (c) interleaved: spk:0 'Priya Nair, what do you think about the rules?' then a one-turn spk:2 'Yes please.' then spk:1 (true Priya), second quote from spk:3 the same way; {spk:2,Priya Nair,called-on} ships spk:2=Priya Nair (wrong). The original ISS-U24SMART-001 fixture (thanks, 5 kinds) is refused. Cause: the gate verifies only that the name occurs in a quote with a forward cue and that a block follows; it cannot tell which of several names in the quote is the addressee, and 'block right after the quote turn' ignores short interjection blocks. Independent-speaker corroboration is satisfied by a host and a cohost repeating the same shape.
fix_direction: Require the name to be the sole name in the quote or the one addressed (vocative at the cue), skip or abstain when the quote names a second person; do not bind to a block shorter than a minimum length or when an interjecting label sits between quote and answer; add these three fixtures as regressions.
